title: Fourier Weight of the Balanced Lift
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function and let $i$ be a coordinate. Form a function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional cube by first swapping coordinate $0$ with coordinate $i+1$, then applying the balanced lift, whose value at $z$ is $z_0 f((z_0z_{j+1})_{j=0}^{n-1})$. The resulting level-one Fourier weight equals the Fourier weight of $f$ on levels zero and one combined.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional cube
